demonstration.narration: I'll open the records behind the spike, with the service filter and window intact, to check what the failing requests have in common.
demonstration.reasoning: A spike is a count. Its underlying records show whether the failures share one route and one error, or are unrelated noise that happens to coincide.
demonstration.evidence: The records behind the spike are ${truth.finding} requests to ${truth.scope} failing with CheckoutStateConflict, in the same window and filter as the chart. ${truth.conclusion}
